judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after the TDD planning/red-test phase and did not implement any production code. The diff only contains `.lore/dod.md`, an acceptance test file (`src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`), and a brief spec addition in `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`. None of the required source files (`src/types/messages.ts`, `src/types/session.ts`, `src/transport/ws/validation.ts`, `src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts`, `src/transport/createServer.ts`, `src/config.ts`, etc.) or documentation files (`CHANGELOG.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, `docs/getting-started.md`) were modified. Consequently, all new tests in the candidate's diff will fail and none of the acceptance criteria are satisfied.
